question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beat.line: The Resulticks acquisition is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
beat.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
beat.action: Two halftone documents slide together from opposite edges; an arrow drops between them and holds.

sources: based on the showcase material provided earlier, the Resulticks acquisition is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: soft violet. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: two paper documents; a torn-paper arrow.
Opens cold on the ground colour; the first subject enters on the first frame.
Action: Two halftone documents slide together from opposite edges; an arrow drops between them and holds.
Ends holding on the joined documents.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "REVENUE SYNERGY".

COPY LIST: "REVENUE SYNERGY". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The Resulticks acquisition is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage. The scene opens on a solid, flat block-color background of soft violet with a matte paper texture. From the first frame, two black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of business documents, characterized by rough white torn-paper edges and small drop shadows cast from an upper-left light source, slide rapidly into the frame from opposite horizontal edges. They move with a fast speed and a slight overshoot before landing in a stable, side-by-side position in the center of the composition. Simultaneously, a flat matte cream-colored paper arrow with torn edges drops vertically from the top of the frame, landing precisely between the two documents. A rectangular paper chip in cream enters the frame, featuring the headline "REVENUE SYNERGY" printed in a large, extra-bold black sans-serif typeface; the text is clean, legible, and stable. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range timbre speaking at a brisk but unhurried rate, speaks the following line: <d>[English] The Resulticks acquisition is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.</d> The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5 seconds. As the elements hold their final positions, they maintain a subtle, slow-looping micro-bobbing motion to signify they are layered paper.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the clear vocal delivery of the narrator. Layered beneath the voice are synchronized diegetic sound effects: two distinct, crisp paper-slap sounds as the documents land, and a short, tacky adhesive sound of tape being pressed down as the arrow and headline chip lock into place.
